evidence.claim: Flagged transaction 3660260 ($2.90, product C, online) scores 0.00 on the calibrated transaction model trained only on the bank's closed cases (out-of-time AUC 0.964 vs 0.866 for the bank's risk score). The bank's own risk score was 0.04.
Card baseline from 198 earlier transactions: median $57.99, 95th percentile $458.82; the flagged amount is 0.1x the median.

Cardholder C12975 reported the $2.90 charge as not theirs (case pack trigger, 2017-01-26 21:09:37). Measured on October: all 1,203 disputes the bank investigated were fraud, 15% of them scored under 0.05, so a low score does not clear a denial (0.93). If this is a planted dispute on a legitimate transaction, a score this size is 0.07x as likely on disputed fraud as on a legitimate transaction (0.07). Weighted equally: 0.76.
Card-not-present fraud: the number used online without the card; amounts and products that don't fit the cardholder, often two to four within 48 hours.
Policy R2: Customer denies the transaction: BLOCK_CARD and CREATE_CASE; FILE_REPORT if exposure exceeds $1,000 or the case connects to a shared device profile or another card's fraud.
